page_title: BAR 4-2 VAL | Barcelona v Valencia 29/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' 4 - 2 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) takes a wonderful free kick and curls the ball into the top left corner with an absolutely phenomenal strike!
90+2' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
90+2' Thierry Correia (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90+1' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is about to take a corner kick.
90+1' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 25:5.
89' The Barcelona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
86' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
86' The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
85' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
83' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
83' The Barcelona players halt their celebrations as referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
82' 3 - 2 Goal! Ronald Araujo gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) glances a header into the net. 3:2.
81' Barcelona have a corner.
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Joao Cancelo will be replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
80' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
79' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) replacing Peter Federico.
79' A substitution has been made. Diego Lopez is replaced by Sergi Canos (Valencia).
78' Joao Felix (Barcelona) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Jaume Domenech easily makes the save.
77' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
77' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
77' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
76' 16:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

75' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Jaume Domenech.
75' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
74' The corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is cleared away by the defence.
73' Diego Lopez (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

73' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
73' Corner kick. Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fermin Lopez leaves the pitch and Pedri (Barcelona) comes on.
72' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
72' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
72' Joao Felix (Barcelona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
71' Substitution. Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) has come on for Javi Guerra.
70' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Alberto Mari (Valencia) replaces Hugo Duro.
70' The attendance for today's match is 30167.
69' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
66' Substitution. Raphinha did his best and is replaced by Joao Felix (Barcelona).
64' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) brings his opponent down. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is caught offside!
61' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Jaume Domenech.
60' Barcelona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
57' The possession of the ball – 81:19.
56' The foul by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) was seen by Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
56' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Jaume Domenech comes off his line to gather the ball.

54' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Jaume Domenech easily catches the ball.
54' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
54' Total attempts – 11:5.
52' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Valencia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Barcelona players have a reason to celebrate!
50' Wait! Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has indicated he is going to review the Barcelona goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

49' 2 - 2 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Ilkay Gundogan. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the right post behind the goalkeeper. It's 2:2.
49' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

49' This shall not pass! Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
49' Raphinha (Barcelona) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
48' A pass into the penalty area from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is intercepted by the defence. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
48' The game is interrupted as Hugo Duro (Valencia) is flagged offside.
46' Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
46' Xavi has made a change at the break. Inigo Martinez has come on in place of Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona).
46' Half-time substitution. Xavi decided to make a change. Andreas Christensen is replaced by Sergi Roberto (Barcelona).
46' Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+10' The end of the first half.
45+9' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45+7' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
45+7' Raphinha (Barcelona) fires the resulting free kick to the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but Jaume Domenech pulls off a superb save to deny him.
45+7' Barcelona are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
45+6' Ruben Baraja is forced to make a tactical change due to a red card. Andre Almeida will be replaced by Jaume Domenech (Valencia).
45+4' Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia).
45+3' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia)! Let's see what he decides.
45+1' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) sees his header crash off the right post after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
45+1' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) prepares to take a corner kick.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45' Raphinha (Barcelona) will deliver the corner kick.
45' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
44' Giorgi Mamardashvili leaps to intercept the corner kick from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona).
44' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the top left corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
42' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
42' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.
39' 2:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
38' 1 - 2 Goal! Pepelu (Valencia) calmly steps up and places the ball into the middle of the goal.
38' Pepelu (Valencia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
36' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. A penalty is given to Valencia!
36' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.
35' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona).
33' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle and it's Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
32' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
31' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
30' The corner kick from Pepelu (Valencia) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
30' The ball is cleared after Andre Almeida (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
28' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
27' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Valencia players aren’t happy.
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes a huge mistake and Hugo Duro (Valencia) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
27' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
25' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
24' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

22' 1 - 0 Goal – 1:0! Raphinha sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) rises above the defenders near the penalty spot to meet the ball and heads it straight into the top right corner.
20' Peter Federico (Valencia) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
20' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Giorgi Mamardashvili, who smothers the ball.
20' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Giorgi Mamardashvili has no trouble gathering it.
19' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) attempts to find Fermin Lopez with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
19' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is penalised for a foul. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea had a clear view and blows his whistle.
17' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' A pass from Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is intercepted by Giorgi Mamardashvili and the move breaks down.

14' Hugo Duro (Valencia) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who pulls off a decent save!
13' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
13' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
12' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
10' The ratio of the ball possession is 80:20.
9' Javi Guerra (Valencia) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
8' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) tries to find Raphinha, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
8' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
7' A cross into the box from Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is cleared.
6' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
4' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comes off his line to gather the ball.
3' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul after Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
